paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.48 as of November 16, 2026, with a decrease of 4.98 percent from the prior close and 17.88 percent over the last 21 sessions.

Recent news includes an announcement from Tech Times on November 14, 2026, that Fermi Project Matador received a $200 million hyperscaler prepayment toward 600 MW, but no signed lease is in place before year-end.

There have been several recent SEC filings, including a Form 4 filed on November 16, 2026, and a Form 144 filed on November 12, 2026, as well as a 10-Q filing on November 12, 2026, which disclosed the company's Q3 2026 financial and operational updates.
